key_policy_context: Launch of FAME-I initial pilot & demonstration projects
Demand incentive expansion to hybrid and electric vehicles
Mild hybrids removed from subsidy list; pure EV push begins
Final extension of FAME-I; drafting of FAME-II guidelines
FAME-II rollout (Rs 10,000 Cr outlay); focus on public transport & commercial 3W/2W
COVID-19 market disruption; factory closures and supply chain delays
FAME-II amendment: 2W subsidy raised to Rs 15k/kWh; EV sales inflection
PMP compliance audits initiated; OEM subsidy claims paused for scrutiny
June 2023 2W subsidy cut to Rs 10k/kWh; clawback notices to 7 OEMs; FAME-II expiration
